scenarios.theme: Every sixty-second poll receives a gateway timeout after thirty seconds. What changes?
scenarios.assumptions: The server holds requests for sixty seconds, but a production intermediary terminates them at thirty. Clients immediately reconnect and logs fill with errors. What will you do?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

scenarios.theme: An event arrives between checking data and registering a waiter. How do you prevent a stall?

scenarios.theme: A brief outage makes all clients reconnect in a tight loop. What protects the service?
scenarios.assumptions: Poll failures return instantly during recovery, turning thousands of waiting clients into a request storm. How will you keep useful traffic available?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.
